geometryScope.policy: European land components only; no overseas insets. Longitude starts at -22 so Iceland stays and the Azores (east of -26 to -25) and Madeira (south of 34) do not.

excluded.RU: Spans two continents; a frame that shows it whole shrinks the rest of the map.
excluded.TR: Spans two continents; most of it lies in Asia.
excluded.GE: Caucasus state; not part of the Europe frame.
excluded.AM: Caucasus state; not part of the Europe frame.
excluded.AZ: Caucasus state; not part of the Europe frame.

merged.CYN: Northern Cyprus joins CY (EU view: one island).
merged.ESB: Dhekelia base area joins CY so the island has no gap.
merged.WSB: Akrotiri base area joins CY so the island has no gap.

markers: Not listed by hand. A member is an outline when it draws at least 8 px2 on the 800 px canvas and a marker below that.
